title: Uruguayan Empanadas with a German Twist
description: A delicious twist on traditional empanadas, filled with crumbly cheese and a hint of German flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add in the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add in the water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead a few times until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of uruguayan cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with a little bit of water and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
